events.title: 밀월 go top of the league in their first season in the First Division with a 3–2 win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스. 노리치 시티's 3–1 home defeat to 찰턴 애슬레틱 pushes them down to second place. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 go bottom of the division with a 4–1 home defeat to 아스널. 입스위치 타운 go top of the Second Division with a 2–1 away win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. Bottom-of-the-table Birmingham lose a thrilling game at home to 반즐리 5–3.
Soviet Union wins the Olympic gold medal in football by defeating Brazil : 2–1 after extra time in Seoul 's Olympic Stadium .
애스턴 빌라 sell defender Neale Cooper to 레인저스 for £300,000.
더비 카운티 manager Arthur Cox dismisses speculation that he will take over at 리즈 유나이티드.

노리치 시티 return to the top of the First Division with a 1–0 win over 더비 카운티 at the Baseball Ground . Second Division promotion challengers 블랙번 로버스 beat 크리스털 팰리스 5–4 in a nine-goal thriller at Ewood Park .
Jackie Milburn , 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's record goal scorer who helped them win three FA Cups during the 1950s, dies of cancer aged 64.

Howard Wilkinson ends six years as 셰필드 웬즈데이 manager by agreeing to drop down a division to join 리즈 유나이티드, while Willie McFaul ends his 22-year association with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 when he is sacked as manager. Reserve team coach Colin Suggett is put in charge, with the club's board saying that he will stay in the role until the end of the season.
Ron Atkinson steps down as 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 manager for the second time, taking over at 아틀레티코 마드리드 in Spain, in a contract worth £250,000 per year.

밀월 miss the chance to go back to the top of the First Division when Coventry hold them to a goalless draw at Highfield Road . A West Midlands derby at St Andrew's sees 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beat their local rivals 버밍엄 시티 4–1. 첼시 boost their hopes of an immediate return to the First Division by beating 올덤 애슬레틱 4–1 at Boundary Park .
리버풀 midfielder Jan Molby is found guilty of reckless driving and driving under the influence of alcohol , and is sentenced to three months in prison.
리버풀 sign 20-year-old defender David Burrows from 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 for £550,000.
윔블던 pay a club record £500,000 for Reading defender Keith Curle .

사우샘프턴 make history by fielding three brothers in the same team in their 2–1 league defeat to 셰필드 웬즈데이: 24-year-old Danny Wallace lines up alongside twin brothers Rod and Ray . 노리치 시티 maintain their lead of the First Division with a 3–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼, which sends the visitors into the bottom three. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 remain in the bottom three despite a 2–0 win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, which sends the Tynesiders back to the bottom of the table. 첼시's Second Division surge continues with a 5–0 home win over 플리머스 아가일.

토트넘 홋스퍼 remain in the bottom three after losing 2–1 at home to 사우샘프턴, who climb from tenth place to fifth. 아스널's title hopes are dented when they are held to a 1–1 draw by 루턴 타운 at Kenilworth Road . 왓퍼드 go top of the Second Division with a 4–0 home win over 반즐리.

노리치 시티 strengthen their lead of the First Division with a 2–1 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Old Trafford . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 climb off the bottom of the division with a 3–0 home win over local rivals 미들즈브러. 리버풀 are seventh after a 2–1 defeat to 노팅엄 포리스트 at the City Ground .
맨체스터 유나이티드 pay 루턴 타운 £650,000 for 31-year-old full-back Mal Donaghy .
더비 카운티 pay a club-record £1million for 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 and Wales striker Dean Saunders .

Mark Lawrenson is sacked as 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 manager after a dispute with the club's board over the sale of Dean Saunders. His assistant Brian Horton , the former 헐 시티 manager, is appointed as his successor. First Division leaders 노리치 시티 draw 1–1 at home to 사우샘프턴, while 아스널 climb into second place with a 2–0 home win over 코번트리 시티. 리버풀 get back on track with a 2–0 win at 웨스트햄 유나이티드. In the Second Division, there is a seven-goal thriller at the Manor Ground , where 브래드퍼드 시티 beat 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 4–3.

에버턴 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 1–1 in a First Division encounter at Goodison Park . Both teams were among the pre-season title favourites but have so far been disappointing in the league, with 에버턴 14th and United 10th. 토트넘 홋스퍼, another team widely expected to challenge for the title this season, are currently second from bottom.

노리치 시티 are back at the top of the First Division table at the end of the month, now with a six-point lead over nearest rivals 아스널, who have a game in hand, while 밀월 are still third. The bottom three places are occupied by 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 미들즈브러, who two seasons ago were in the Third Division and threatened with closure due to financial problems, finish the month in a creditable seventh place. 왓퍼드 lead the Second Division by five points over 블랙번 로버스. The playoff zone is occupied by 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 포츠머스, 첼시 and 맨체스터 시티 . 리즈 유나이티드 continue to struggle, only being out of the relegation zone on goal difference.
